newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Abigroup wins A$11m Olympic road deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Abigroup wins A$11m Olympic road deal.

text.p: Construction company Abigroup Ltd won an A$11 million road construction contract for the Homebush Olympic Games site, the New South Wales (NSW) acting minister for the Sydney 2000 Olympics, Carl Scully, said on Friday.
"The project involves 2.5 km of road pavements, water cycle pipeline, utility provisions, power for lighting, landscaping and stormwater provisions," Scully said in a statement.
He said the development was in accordance with the state government's Homebush Bay masterplan and was an essential part of the infrastructure required.
The NSW government's Olympic Co-ordination Authority is responsible for about 15 km of new and upgraded roadworks at Homebush Bay, Scully said.
"Tenders for other road packages will be sought progressively in coming months," he said.
